lead: Shelf-stable and store-cupboard foods to cook with — oils, grains, pasta, pulses, flour, spices, sauces, preserves, dried fruit, sweet spreads and home-brew ingredients — organised by type, with protected origins, named varieties and producers as archetypes where enthusiasts compare them.

b.v: Great Taste 3 stars > 2 stars > 1 star > none
b.w: A blind-judged award across food types; under 2% of entries reach three stars.
EU and national schemes bind method and place; shoppers filter by them.

b.v: Slow Food Presidium > Ark of Taste listing > none
b.w: Slow Food selects distinctive local products at risk.
How the product is kept is an attribute shown on each kind, not a separate kind.
Organic and non-GMO lead the filters; these are filters, not a quality ladder.

depts.note: Tier for everyday oils and fats; variety for olive oil and balsamic.

b.v: extra virgin > virgin > olive oil (refined blend) > pomace
b.w: Less refined oil keeps its flavour; the grade is read first on the label.

b.m: Olive oil harvest date and freshness
b.v: this season's harvest > last season's > undated
b.w: The freshest oil is for finishing; older oil is for cooking.

b.v: dark glass or tin > clear glass or plastic
b.w: Light-proof packs keep oil from spoiling.
Independent competitions name the best oils.

b.v: Tradizionale DOP Extravecchio (25 yr) > Tradizionale DOP Affinato (12 yr) > Balsamico di Modena IGP Invecchiato > IGP > condiment
b.w: The designation fixes method and ingredients; longer ageing gives denser vinegar.

s.brief: Rebuild olive oil as PDO/PGI origin → cultivar → producer. Archetypes = the major protected oils and regional styles (e.g. Toscano IGP, Riviera Ligure DOP, Terra di Bari DOP, Val di Mazara DOP, Priego de Córdoba DOP, Baena DOP, Siurana DOP, Sitia Lasithi PDO, Kalamata PDO, Moura DOP, Nyons AOP, Les Baux-de-Provence AOP), each with its main cultivars in dt (Picual, Arbequina, Hojiblanca, Koroneiki, Coratina, Frantoio, Leccino, Taggiasca, Tanche) and named producers or NYIOOC winners as versions. Grades (extra virgin, virgin, olive oil, pomace) go in t. Keep supermarket brands only as market-covering models (Bertolli, Filippo Berio, Colavita, Carapelli…). Add a Mediterranean olive-oil tradition entry if sourced.

k.brief: Grades as t; archetypes per PDO/PGI and regional style.

s.brief: Tier shelf: market-covering brands plus test winners, ≤ ~8 models per kind. Add the missing everyday oils (groundnut, coconut, avocado, nut and seed oils incl. Steirisches Kürbiskernöl PGI and argan) and vegetable shortening. Toasted vs plain sesame oil, cold-pressed vs refined, virgin vs refined coconut as t. Rename lard kind to cover poultry fats (duck, goose, schmaltz) as t.

k.brief: Alias canola; cold-pressed vs refined as t.
Toasted vs plain as t; Kadoya etc.
Walnut, hazelnut, pumpkin seed (Steirisches Kürbiskernöl PGI), argan, flaxseed as t or archetypes.
Crisco, Trex, Cookeen.

s.brief: Archetypes for protected and named vinegars: Aceto Balsamico Tradizionale di Modena DOP and di Reggio Emilia DOP (age tiers as versions), Aceto Balsamico di Modena IGP; Vinagre de Jerez DOP, Montilla-Moriles, Banyuls, Orléans-method wine vinegar; Chinkiang (Zhenjiang) and Shanxi mature vinegar, Japanese komezu/kurozu. Producers (Giusti, Malpighi, Leonardi…) as versions/brands. Add cane and coconut vinegars (Filipino sukang Iloko, sukang tuba) as one new kind. Add Chinese black vinegar / balsamic traditions if sourced.

k.brief: Sherry vinegar, red/white wine, Champagne vinegar as t or archetypes.
Japanese rice vinegar, Chinese black vinegars (Chinkiang, Shanxi).

depts.note: Tier for everyday packs; variety for named rice varieties, pasta makers and Japanese noodles.

b.w: Variety (1121, Pusa, Koshihikari, Carnaroli) sets grain and taste.
Trade grades premium rice by its share of broken grains.
Aged basmati cooks to longer grains and costs more.
The Japan Grain Inspection Association ranks rice by area and variety against a reference blend.
Bronze dies give a rough surface that holds sauce; Pasta di Gragnano IGP fixes method and place.

s.brief: Archetypes = named varieties and protected rices: basmati (Pusa 1121, Traditional/Taraori, Super Kernel; Dehraduni), Thai Hom Mali, Koshihikari (Uonuma), Akitakomachi, Hitomebore, Tsuyahime, Yumepirika, Calrose; Sona Masoori, Samba, Gobindobhog; Carnaroli, Arborio, Vialone Nano IGP, Acquerello; Bomba, Calasparra DOP, Valencia DOP; Thai/Lao glutinous; Forbidden black rice, Camargue red, Bhutanese red. Japanese rice grades (Toku-A) in brief/dt. Brown, parboiled, polished as t. Trim packaged SKUs to a few market brands (Tilda, Daawat, India Gate, Uncle Ben's/Ben's Original).

k.brief: Brown and parboiled as t.
Japanese varieties and grades; Indian table rices.

s.brief: Organise as shape family → named shape (spaghetti, bucatini, linguine; penne, rigatoni, paccheri; fusilli, farfalle, orecchiette, conchiglie; tagliatelle, pappardelle; orzo, stelline) ordered by significance; Pasta di Gragnano IGP and bronze-die artisan makers (Afeltra, Faella, Di Martino, Pastificio dei Campi, Setaro, Rummo, Garofalo, Martelli, Cavalieri, Felicetti) plus market makers (Barilla, De Cecco) in the brand register, not repeated per kind. Add filled pasta (tortellini, ravioli, agnolotti; chilled or dried as storage t) and couscous (incl. Israeli/pearl and fregola as t).

Archetypes = named regional noodles: Sanuki, Inaniwa, Mizusawa udon, Kishimen; Izumo, Togakushi, Ni-hachi/Juwari soba; Miwa and Ibo no Ito (Handa) somen; Longkou vermicelli, Korean dangmyeon; Chinese lamian, wonton/egg noodles, knife-cut; rice vermicelli, ho fun, pho, Guilin, sen lek. Add instant noodles as their own kind with icons (Nissin Chicken Ramen 1958, Cup Noodles, Shin Ramyun, Indomie Mi Goreng, Mama, Maggi 2-Minute) — reviewers such as The Ramen Rater give test-winner evidence. Add rice noodles, Chinese wheat and egg noodles, konjac (shirataki).

k.brief: Fresh and dried alkaline noodles; instant now separate.

depts.note: Tier for everyday grains and cereals; variety at the heirloom-bean and protected-pulse end.

b.w: Named beans and lentils (Puy, Castelluccio, Tarbais) are sought for texture and flavour.
Old dried pulses cook unevenly and stay hard.

s.brief: New shelf. Tier: market-covering icons and brands (Kellogg's Corn Flakes, Weetabix, Cheerios, Shredded Wheat, Rice Krispies, Alpen, Dorset Cereals, Quaker Oats, Flahavan's) plus test winners (Which?, CHOICE). Cereal bars are in J8. Porridge oats (k37) move here; jumbo, rolled, quick, steel-cut/pinhead as t.

k.brief: Old 'Rolled oats'; steel-cut and quick oats as t.
Flakes, puffed, shredded wheat, biscuit cereals as t.

s.brief: Tier. Merge bulgur into cracked wheat. Add polenta/cornmeal (grits as t), farro and ancient wheats (spelt grain, emmer, einkorn, freekeh), and an 'Edible seeds' kind combining old sunflower and hemp seeds with chia, flax, pumpkin and sesame seeds as t. Archetypes only where named protected grains exist (e.g. Farro della Garfagnana IGP, Polenta Taragna, Mexican heirloom maize).

k.brief: Sunflower, hemp, chia, flax, pumpkin, sesame as t.

s.brief: Archetypes for heirloom and protected beans: Judión de La Granja, Fabada Asturiana PGI faba, Haricot Tarbais PGI, Fagiolo di Sorana PGI, Fagioli di Lamon PGI, Gigantes Kastorias PGI, Rajma Jammu/Chakrata, and the Rancho Gordo heirloom range. Add adzuki beans (sweet bean paste link). Keep definitions plain.

No new kinds. Archetypes for named lentils and chickpeas: Lentille verte du Puy AOP, Lenticchia di Castelluccio di Norcia IGP, Beluga, Lentilles vertes du Berry PGI, Lenteja de La Armuña PGI; Garbanzo de Escacena PGI, Garbanzo de Fuentesaúco PGI; kabuli vs desi as t. Split, whole and husked forms as t for dals.

depts.note: Tier for everyday baking; variety for Italian and artisan flours and vanilla.

b.w: Protein sets gluten strength and what the flour bakes well.
Italian law grades soft-wheat flour by ash (how much bran is left).

b.v: white > golden > light brown > dark muscovado > jaggery/panela
b.w: Less refined sugar keeps more molasses and flavour.

s.brief: Archetypes for named flours: Caputo Pizzeria/Cuoco/Nuvola, Molino Dallagiovanna, Petra, Manitoba, French T45/T55/T65 types, King Arthur, Shipton Mill, Wildfarmed; Italian Tipo and French T grades in dt. Self-raising and cake flour as t of plain flour. Trim to ≤ ~8 models per kind.

k.brief: Self-raising and cake flour as t.

s.brief: Tier. Merge urad and moong flour. Add masa harina (nixtamalised maize; Maseca, heirloom maize brands), cornflour and starches (cornstarch, potato starch, arrowroot, tapioca starch as t), and gluten-free flour blends (Doves Farm, Bob's Red Mill, Caputo Fioreglut).

k.brief: Glutinous rice flour (mochiko) as t.

s.brief: Tier for refined sugar; archetypes for traditional unrefined sugars: jaggery (gur), panela/piloncillo, Okinawan kokuto, wasanbon, gula melaka/palm sugar, rapadura. Add palm and coconut sugar and sugar substitutes (stevia, erythritol, sucralose; Truvia, Splenda, Canderel).

k.brief: Rename aliases: gur · panela · piloncillo.

s.brief: Tier. Merge the four pastry kinds (old 'Other unbaked pastry', puff, shortcrust, filo) into one kind with t types and chilled/frozen storage. Add bicarbonate of soda to baking powder; add baking extracts and flower waters (almond, peppermint, orange blossom, rose water) and food colouring and cake decorations (sprinkles, sugarpaste, gel colours; Dr. Oetker, Wilton, Renshaw). Baking chocolate moves to J8; vanilla moves to Prized spices.

k.n: Baking powder and bicarbonate of soda

k.brief: Puff, shortcrust, filo, pizza dough as t; chilled/frozen storage.

depts.note: Variety for prized spices, blends and finishing salts; tier for everyday ground spices.

b.w: The ISO lab test measures colour, taste and aroma strength.

b.v: Grade A (gourmet, 30%+ moisture) > Grade B (extract, drier)
b.w: Moisture and appearance set use and price.

b.v: Tellicherry Garbled Extra Bold > Tellicherry Garbled > Malabar Garbled
b.w: Indian trade grades sort black pepper by berry size.
Whole spices keep their oils far longer than ground.

s.brief: Variety shelf, archetypes by origin/grade: saffron (Iranian sargol/negin/pushal, Kashmir GI, Azafrán de La Mancha DOP, Zafferano dell'Aquila DOP, Krokos Kozanis PDO); vanilla (Bourbon/Madagascar, Tahitian, Mexican, Ugandan, Indian; beans, extract, paste as t; Nielsen-Massey, Heilala); pepper (Tellicherry, Malabar, Kampot PGI, Penja, Lampong, Sarawak; black/white/green as t; pink peppercorns as t note); Sichuan pepper (Hanyuan); cinnamon (Ceylon alba/C5 grades, Korintje, Saigon cassia); cardamom (Alleppey green, black); nutmeg and mace (Grenada, Banda); paprika (Pimentón de la Vera DOP, Szegedi/Kalocsai fűszerpaprika PDO); dried chilli (Kashmiri, Aleppo/pul biber, Espelette AOP, ancho, guajillo, chipotle, gochugaru). Add spice-trade traditions only if sourced.

k.brief: Was 'Vanilla and baking flavourings'; other extracts move to Baking extracts.

s.brief: Tier: market-covering spice brands (Schwartz/McCormick, Rajah, MDH, Everest, TRS, Simply Organic, Burlap & Barrel, The Spice House) plus test winners. Whole vs ground as t. Dried herbs as one kind with t (oregano, thyme, bay, rosemary, basil, mint, dill).

Archetypes per named blend with origin; makers as versions (MDH, Everest, Shan). Merge nothing else. New kinds: curry powder, ras el hanout, za'atar, Chinese five-spice, shichimi togarashi, berbere, herbes de Provence and mixed herbs, barbecue rubs and seasonings (Cajun, jerk, Tajín as archetypes).

k.n: Herbes de Provence and mixed herbs

s.brief: Merge low-sodium salt into table salt as t (iodised, low-sodium). Archetypes for finishing and named salts: Maldon, Halen Môn PDO, Jacobsen, Cornish Sea Salt; Fleur de sel de Guérande IGP, Camargue, Île de Ré; Himalayan pink, Persian blue, Korean bamboo salt (jukyeom), Hawaiian alaea; Diamond Crystal and Morton for kosher. Add smoked and flavoured salt, and black salt (kala namak).

depts.note: Tier for table sauces and stock; variety for hot sauces and Asian fermented seasonings.

b.w: The Japanese Agricultural Standard grades soy sauce by nitrogen, extract and colour within each type.

b.v: naturally brewed (honjozo, wooden-barrel kioke) > mixed > chemically hydrolysed
b.w: Long natural fermentation gives depth; hydrolysed sauces are cheaper and harsher.
Hot sauces and chillies are compared by measured pungency.

s.brief: Tier: icons and market-covering brands plus test winners per kind (Heinz, Hellmann's, Kewpie, Duke's, Colman's, Maille, Lea & Perrins, HP). Archetypes only for named regional styles: mustard (Dijon, Moutarde de Meaux, English, Bavarian sweet, American yellow), barbecue sauce (Kansas City, Carolina mustard/vinegar, Texas, Alabama white). Add brown sauce (HP, Daddies).

Variety shelf (collector community, Hot Ones). Hot sauce archetypes by style and icon: Louisiana (Tabasco 1868, Crystal, Frank's RedHot, Louisiana Brand), Mexican (Cholula, Valentina, Tapatío, El Yucateco), sriracha (Sriraja Panich, Huy Fong), Caribbean scotch bonnet (Encona, Marie Sharp's), peri-peri (Nando's), craft/superhot (Yellowbird, Secret Aardvark, The Last Dab); versions = variants. Chilli crisp icons (Lao Gan Ma, Fly By Jing); chilli pastes sambal oelek, harissa (Tunisian, UNESCO-listed), nam prik pao, 'zhug'. Add jarred salsa as a new kind.

Variety: shoyu and miso as traditions (tradition entries for Japanese shoyu brewing incl. Yuasa, Shōdoshima kioke brewing, and Korean jang-making, UNESCO 2024). Soy sauce archetypes by type (koikuchi, usukuchi, tamari, saishikomi, shiro) with brewers as versions (Kikkoman, Yamasa, Higashimaru, Yamaroku, Marukin, San-J). Miso archetypes: Hatcho (mame), Saikyo (shiro), Shinshu, mugi, Sendai; Korean doenjang. Gochujang (Sunchang). Mirin hon-mirin vs mirin-fu as t. Add dashi and dashi ingredients (kombu varieties Rishiri/Rausu/Ma, katsuobushi, niboshi, instant hondashi), ponzu and tsuyu, furikake.

k.brief: Japanese miso and Korean doenjang as archetypes.

s.brief: Variety: fish sauce archetypes (Phú Quốc PDO, Phan Thiết; Red Boat, Megachef, Squid, Three Crabs; colatura di alici di Cetara as the Italian relative); oyster sauce (Lee Kum Kee 1888) and hoisin; Pixian doubanjiang (GI); Shaoxing huangjiu cooking wine (rename kind 'Shaoxing and Chinese cooking wine'); fermented bean curd (white, red, chou doufu). Add black bean sauce and douchi (Yangjiang), XO sauce, shrimp paste (belacan, terasi, kapi, bagoong), kecap manis (ABC, Bango), tamarind paste.

Tier: market-covering brands plus test winners (Rao's, Mutti, Dolmio, Patak's, Mae Ploy, Knorr, Oxo, Maggi, Better Than Bouillon). Pesto alla Genovese with Basilico Genovese DOP as archetype. Add jarred cooking sauces (curry, stir-fry and simmer sauces), gravy granules, and liquid seasonings (Maggi Seasoning, Bragg, Aromat).

depts.note: Tier for tins; variety for olives and named ferments. Tinned fish is in Fish & Seafood, tinned meat in Meat & Poultry.

b.v: Pomodoro San Marzano dell'Agro Sarnese-Nocerino DOP > Italian plum > other
b.w: The DOP fixes variety and place; many 'San Marzano style' tins are not DOP.

s.brief: Tier with icons: Heinz Baked Beans, Campbell's condensed soup, Mutti, Cento, La Valle, Del Monte, Green Giant. Archetypes for San Marzano DOP and Pomodorino del Piennolo del Vesuvio DOP tomatoes. Add tinned beans and pulses (baked beans as archetype), tinned vegetables, tinned soup and tinned fruit.

Variety at the olive and ferment end: table olive archetypes (Kalamata PDO, Castelvetrano/Nocellara del Belice DOP, Gordal, Manzanilla, Taggiasca, Nyons AOP, Niçoise, Lucques, Picholine); kimchi (gimjang tradition, UNESCO) with baechu, kkakdugi, oi-sobagi as archetypes; Spreewälder Gurken PGI, cornichons. Add capers (Pantelleria PGI, Salina), chutneys and relishes (Branston, mango chutney), Indian pickles (achar: mango, lime), Japanese pickles (umeboshi, takuan, tsukemono).

depts.note: New department: dried fruit was missing; dried mushrooms and seaweed join it.

b.w: Dates, apricots and prunes are bought by variety and origin.

b.v: unsulphured, no added sugar > sulphured or sweetened
b.w: Sulphur keeps colour; sugar infusion changes taste.

s.brief: New kinds, archetypes by variety and origin: dates (Medjool, Deglet Nour, Ajwa, Sukkari, Khalas, Mazafati), raisins (Thompson seedless, Flame, Malaga muscatels, Vostizza currants PDO, sultanas, Corinthian currants), apricots (Malatya, Hunza, Californian Blenheim), prunes (Pruneaux d'Agen IGP, d'Ente plum), figs (Aydın/Smyrna, Calimyrna), cranberries and berries (Ocean Spray Craisins), tropical (Philippine mango), apple and pear rings. Candied fruit is in J8; snack nuts in J8.

Archetypes: dried porcini (Fungo di Borgotaro IGP), shiitake grades (donko, koshin), morels, wood ear; nori (Ariake), wakame (Naruto), hijiki, dulse, kelp/kombu cross-link to dashi. Add sun-dried tomatoes (dried and in oil as t).

depts.note: Variety for honey and maple; tier for jams and spreads.

b.w: Called the single most important factor in honey; a choice, not a ladder.
Measured markers grade manuka strength; UMF Honey Association licenses the mark.

b.v: Grade A Golden Delicate · Amber Rich · Dark Robust · Very Dark Strong
b.w: The international grading names colour and taste classes.

s.brief: Merge clover, acacia and buckwheat honey into one 'Honey' kind with varietal/protected-origin archetypes ordered by significance: acacia (Miere de salcâm), clover, orange blossom, lavender (Miel de Provence IGP), heather, chestnut, buckwheat, tupelo, sourwood, Sidr, thyme (Greek), Miel de Galicia IGP, Corsican AOP. Manuka stays its own kind with UMF/MGO grading and producers (Comvita, Manuka Health). Add honeydew honey (forest, pine, fir). Raw, creamed, comb as t. Add a beekeeping/honey tradition entry if sourced.

k.brief: Varietal archetypes; raw, set, creamed, comb as t.

s.brief: Tier with icons: Bonne Maman, Lyle's Golden Syrup, Tate & Lyle black treacle, Monin, Torani, Skippy, Meridian, Nutella, Marmite, Vegemite. Maple syrup archetypes by origin/grade (Québec, Vermont). Add marmalade (Seville orange), maple syrup, golden syrup, agave and other plant syrups, date syrup and fruit molasses (pomegranate molasses, pekmez), nut and seed butters (almond, cashew, tahini as t), yeast extract spread.

depts.note: Ingredients for making beer, wine and cider at home; equipment is in Kitchen & Dining or Tools.

b.v: current crop/packed date, cold-stored > old stock
b.w: Hops and liquid yeast lose potency with age and warmth.

s.brief: Hobbyist shelf: archetypes for named hop varieties (Saaz, Hallertauer Mittelfrüh, East Kent Goldings, Fuggle, Cascade, Citra, Mosaic, Simcoe, Nelson Sauvin, Galaxy), base and specialty malts (Maris Otter, Golden Promise, Pilsner, Munich, Vienna, crystal, chocolate; Crisp, Simpsons, Weyermann, Briess), yeast strains (Safale US-05, WLP001, Wyeast 1056, Nottingham, Kveik) and malt extract makers. Add beer kits (Coopers, Muntons) and wine and cider kits/grape concentrates. Makers in the brand register.
